title: perch-pet options
description: Options for the perch-pet script. Set them as data-* attributes on the script tag (data-stickiness="0.8"), with `npx perch-pet set key=value`, or pass them to Perch.init({...}).

creature.description: Built-in creature. For your own, use creatureUrl.

creatureUrl.description: URL of a creature JSON file made in the tuner. `npx perch-pet creature ./creature.json` sets this up.

scale.description: Pixel size of one sprite pixel. Default 3 on desktop, 2 on phones.

stickiness.description: How long it stays on a spot before moving on. 0 restless, 1 stays long.

goal.description: CSS selector of the call to action it points at. Default: found automatically.

platforms.description: Extra CSS selector for things it may stand on, added to the automatic ones.

ignore.description: CSS selector for things it must never stand on or point at.

topOffset.description: Pixels kept free at the top of the screen. Default: fixed headers are found automatically.

mobile.description: Run on phones and touch screens.

draggable.description: Let visitors drag and throw it.

bounce.description: Elements dip a few pixels when it lands on them.

zIndex.description: CSS z-index of the creature layer.

tuner.description: Script-tag only. Force the tuner panel on (true) or off (false). Default: on for localhost, off elsewhere.

ask.description: The creature asks the visitor a question in a speech bubble. While it is up the creature stands still, and it goes away when the visitor scrolls. As a data attribute: data-ask='{"text":"...","buttons":[...]}'.

buttons.description: Up to three buttons. The first one is highlighted.

action.description: link: open a URL. copy: copy text. scroll: scroll to a selector. click: click an element. event: send a window event. close: just close. Default: link when there is a value, else close.

value.description: link: the URL (http, https, mailto, tel or a relative path). copy: the text. scroll and click: a CSS selector. event: the event name.

newTab.description: link only: open in a new tab.

delay.description: Seconds on the page before it shows.

once.description: How often one visitor sees it: once per browser session, once ever, or on every visit.

id.description: Remembers that it was seen under this name. Default: made from the text and buttons.
